mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of national passport or identity card of each shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority or national civil registry of the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for apostille-member states; consular legalization for non-Hague states; alternatively notarized true copy certified by a Luxembourg notary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within three months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or depositary bank of the shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Original document with notarized signature; apostille or consular legalization when originating from a non-EU/EEA state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation or official excerpt from the commercial register of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or trade register of the shareholder's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization per country of origin; certified French/German/English translation attached

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association (statutes) and director register of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or competent trade registry of the shareholder's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization according to country of origin; sworn translation into a Luxembourg official language

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate resolution of the shareholder's board or general meeting authorizing the Luxembourg SARL incorporation and appointing the manager (gérant)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Duly convened general meeting or board of directors of the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized signature or apostille; certified translation for filing before the Luxembourg notary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and recent bank statement evidencing source of funds for the initial share capital contribution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Credit institution or bank of the shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Original bank letter with notarized or authenticated signature; apostille or consular legalization for non-EU/EEA banks

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO declaration and corporate ownership chain chart identifying natural persons ultimately owning or controlling more than 25% of capital or exercising control
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate compliance officer, AML counsel, or notary of the shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized execution in Luxembourg or apostilled if executed abroad

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Luxembourg Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies (Loi du 10 août 1915 concernant les sociétés commerciales), as consolidated and amended, particularly Articles 1, 8, 14 and Chapter 4 on SARL; Law of 23 August 2016 on the modernization of commercial law; Law of 10 July 2020 on the digitalization of incorporation formalities
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés - RCS), operated by Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Association (Statuts) executed as a private deed co-signed by all shareholders or as a notarial deed, filed electronically via the RCS e-filing portal and published in the RESA (Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum subscribed share capital: EUR 12,000. At incorporation, at least 25% of each share (minimum EUR 3,000) must be fully paid up and deposited in a blocked escrow account opened with a Luxembourg or EU credit institution; the depositary bank must issue a capital blocking certificate (attestation de blocage) prior to RCS registration; the remaining balance must be paid within five years
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF LU_SARL (Société à Responsabilité Limitée), adopted on [date] in Luxembourg. The shareholder(s), acting as incorporator(s), hereby RESOLVE: (1) to adopt the Articles of Association and subscribe ratably the entire subscribed share capital of EUR 12,000; (2) to approve the banker's attestation evidencing the escrow deposit of at least EUR 3,000 representing the 25% minimum paid-up capital; (3) to establish the registered office at [registered address], Luxembourg; (4) to appoint [Name] as Manager (Gérant) with sole signing authority, effective upon RCS registration; (5) to authorize the manager to complete the RCS filing, RESA publication, and tax and social security registrations. All prior acts are hereby ratified. Signed by all shareholders and the accepting manager.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founders; optional Notary Public (Cabinet de Notaire) or Luxembourg lawyer assisting with private deed legalization
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Statuts in French or German (an English courtesy translation may be attached) containing corporate name, registered office address in Luxembourg, corporate purpose strictly limited to ISIC 6201 DevOps cloud infrastructure activities, share capital structure, management powers, and duration. Execute the deed either as a notarial act or as a private deed signed by all shareholders with legalized signatures; for in-kind contributions (e.g., software IP), obtain a statutory auditor's report (rapport du réviseur d'entreprises) before signature.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Association
Valid national identity cards or passports of all shareholders
Manager's acceptance of office letter (acte de nomination / acceptation)
Declaration of non-conviction and non-bankruptcy (déclaration de non-condamnation) of each manager
Detailed valuation report for any in-kind contribution, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry or notary returns the deed for correction, amend the defective clauses by private deed, re-execute signature pages, and re-submit for legalization; voluntarily restate the Articles if material defects are identified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Blocked Escrow Bank Account and Capital Deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg credit institution (e.g., BIL, BGL BNP Paribas, Spuerkeess) or EU credit institution with Luxembourg branch
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit corporate KYC package to the selected bank and request a specifically restricted corporate account for escrow purposes. Transfer the minimum paid-up capital of EUR 3,000 (representing 25% of EUR 12,000). Obtain from the bank the capital blocking certificate (attestation de blocage) that will be annexed to the RCS filing; the blocking instruction releases funds after registration.
required_dossiers: Notarial or private deed of the Articles of Association (draft acceptable for KYC)
Passport copies and proof of address for all shareholders and managers
Profit and loss projections or business plan for ISIC 6201 cloud tooling
Bank reference or source-of-funds declaration for shareholder contributions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests further KYC clarification, provide a Swiss or EU-based corporate structure chart and audited source-of-funds documents; alternatively, escalate to a second Luxembourg bank with expedited onboarding procedures.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) via the Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) e-filing portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the LBR online portal, complete the registration form for an SARL with commercial or civil activity (ISIC 6201), and upload the executed Articles, capital blocking attestation, manager consent, declaration of non-conviction, and proof of registered office occupancy. Settle the EUR 85 registration fee plus EUR 10 RESA publication fee. Upon approval, the RCS issues the Luxembourg registration number (matricule and RCS number); the deed is published in the RESA electronic gazette within five days.
required_dossiers: Signed and legalized Articles of Association (Statuts)
Bank attestation of blocked minimum paid-up capital (EUR 3,000)
Manager acceptance letter and ID copy
Declaration of non-conviction and non-bankruptcy of each manager
Registered office title: lease agreement or transfer deed of the Luxembourg address (titre de jouissance)
RCS e-filing form completed online
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS issues a query (demande de complément), cure by filing the requested annexes or a rectifying amendment within the registry's two-month deadline; if refusal persists, apply to the District Court of Luxembourg for an order directing registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT); Administration des contributions directes (ACD); Registre National des Contribuables (RNC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the SARL's 13-digit national identification number (matricule) automatically generated by the RCS. File the VAT registration application (Formulaire 1001) with the AEDT to obtain the LU intra-community VAT number; register the corporate income tax file with the ACD and elect the fiscal year-end (generally 31 December); provide the RCS extract and statuts to the tax office.
required_dossiers: RCS registration extract
Certified copy of the Articles of Association
List of authorized signatories and manager ID
Proposed business activity description limited to ISIC 6201 DevOps tools, database and API monitoring services
Bank account evidence for tax communication
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AEDT or ACD queries the file, provide certified French or German translations of the Articles and a detailed activity description; request retroactive effective date of VAT registration consistent with the RCS registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Social Security Registration and Post-Formation Governance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Centre Commun de la Sécurité Sociale (CCSS); Inspection du Travail et des Mines (ITM)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the SARL as an employer with the CCSS, complete affiliated person declarations for any staff, and set up the payroll accounting channel. Establish the internal governance calendar: annual general meeting within six months of fiscal year-end, annual accounts filing with the RCS, and manager's annual report. Obtain an occupational health and safety clearance from ITM where a physical office or server lab is opened.
required_dossiers: RCS extract and Articles of Association
Manager(s) passport and domiciliation certificate
Rental/lease agreement for any physical premises with occupancy certificate
Fire safety and electrical installation inspection certificates
CCSS employer registration form and staff list, if any
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify incomplete CCSS submissions through the eSpace portal; if ITM issues conformity observations, implement the corrective workplace measures and request a follow-up inspection within the stated compliance period.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — ISIC 6201 (computer programming, DevOps cloud infrastructure development) is an unregulated digital services activity that does not require an industrial establishment license under Luxembourg Law of 7 February 2017 on business establishments; commercial activity is exercised under the RCS trade registration alone
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required. No operating permit (autorisation d'exploitation) is mandated for software development, database, API monitoring or cloud tooling services; only general RCS commercial registration and, if applicable, municipal building formality apply for office premises

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'environnement (Environmental Protection Agency of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — no EIA or environmental registration for pure software/cloud infrastructure activities. Should physical server rooms or co-location facilities exceeding 50 kW electrical load be deployed, the project may become subject to screening under the Law of 15 May 2000 on environmental impact assessment (rubrics 10.60/10.65) requiring at least a simplified EIA
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to virtualized cloud operations with zero process wastewater and negligible VOC emissions. Residual compliance obligations: electronic waste disposal under WEEE Directive 2012/19/EU, RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU, and REACH restrictions for hardware assets; if physical racks are introduced, apply EU Best Available Techniques (BAT) for data center energy efficiency and cooling water thresholds

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification (autorisation incendie) issued by the municipal fire service for office premises; structural load inspection of floors for any server cabinets or technical equipment; workplace health and safety clearance from ITM (Inspection du Travail et des Mines) under the Law of 17 June 1994 and Grand-Ducal Regulation of 29 November 1993; periodic electrical installation inspection certificate and emergency evacuation plan for the registered office

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD), Luxembourg Direct Tax Administration, 33 rue de Gasperich, L-5826 Luxembourg (portal: impotsdirects.public.lu and eCDF electronic filing); VAT is administered separately by the Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT); company law filings and business registry access are handled via the Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) and MyGuichet.lu single portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Phase A: Incorporate the SARL by notarial deed and register with the RCS (Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés), which automatically issues the national business registration number (matricule) via the Central Business Register (RCE); the matricule serves as the corporate TIN. Phase B: Submit VAT registration form 810 (Déclaration d'assujettissement à la TVA) to the AEDT through MyGuichet.lu to obtain the Luxembourg VAT number (prefix 'LU' + 8 digits) within 2-4 weeks. Phase C: Apply separately to the Administration des douanes et accises for an EORI number for customs/export operations. Phase D: Obtain the direct tax reference from the ACD upon first lodgment of the corporate income tax and net wealth tax returns in the eCDF system. Non-EU-incorporated foreign entities without a Luxembourg establishment must appoint a Luxembourg VAT fiscal representative; EU-established suppliers may register directly under Article 62 of the 1979 VAT Law.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Luxembourg has no check-the-box or pass-through election for SARLs; all resident SARLs are mandatorily taxed at entity level (IRC, municipal business tax, net wealth tax). Available statutory elections: (i) fiscal integration (intégration fiscale / Vertikalkonsolidierung) under Article 164bis LIR for a 95% directly/indirectly controlled Luxembourg-resident group, irrevocable for at least 5 years; (ii) VAT grouping election under Article 60 of the VAT Act for closely linked Luxembourg-established entities wishing to be treated as a single taxable person; (iii) election for the small-business VAT exemption under Article 57 where annual turnover is below the threshold; (iv) option for intra-Community distance sales to use the EU VAT One-Stop-Shop. Hybrid mismatch rules under ATAD 2 (Law of 25 March 2020) apply mandatorily with no elective carve-out for hybrid instruments or hybrid payer entities.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la valeur ajoutée / TVA) governed by the Law of 12 February 1979, fully harmonized with EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Luxembourg-established suppliers: no mandatory registration until annual taxable turnover exceeds EUR 35,000 (small business exemption, Article 57 of the VAT Act; voluntary registration permitted below threshold). Intra-EU distance sales of e-services into Luxembourg: EUR 10,000 EU-wide threshold before OSS reporting is required. Non-established foreign suppliers: no threshold - mandatory VAT registration from the first taxable transaction in Luxembourg unless the reverse charge mechanism shifts liability to a Luxembourg business customer.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, no SII/continuous transaction control, and no digital stamping regime in Luxembourg. Mandatory B2G e-invoicing to central government bodies via the PEPPOL network in EN 16931 format; B2B e-invoicing remains voluntary, with EN 16931 or a paper/PDF invoice equally acceptable. Invoices must be retained for 10 years. The AEDT may demand periodic VAT listings (recapitulative statements) and intra-Community sales declarations through the eCDF portal.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods: 0% VAT applies to physical exports dispatched or transported outside the European Union by the supplier, by an agent on its behalf, or by an EU-established non-taxable customer, provided the export customs declaration (SAD/AES) is accepted and proof of exit from EU territory is retained (exit must normally occur within 90 days of dispatch). DevOps/SaaS/cloud services: B2B services to EU customers are outside Luxembourg VAT via reverse charge (Article 44 VAT Directive); B2B services to non-EU customers are outside the territorial scope and effectively untaxed (Article 44/59); B2C electronic services to non-EU consumers fall outside Luxembourg VAT, while B2C e-services to EU consumers are taxable at the customer's country rate through the Luxembourg OSS. The strict 0% export mechanism applies only to goods, whereas the software/cloud revenue is relieved through place-of-supply rules.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Electronic export declaration (SAD) in the EU AES system, including the MRN (Movement Reference Number) confirming customs exit
Bill of Lading, CMR, or Air Waybill evidencing physical dispatch from EU territory
Inward Remittance Certificate confirming foreign-currency or B2B payment from the offshore counterparty (recommended substantiation; not a Luxembourg statutory customs requirement)
Commercial invoice, SaaS/cloud license contract, service order, and delivery/acceptance records
EORI number and, where applicable, OSS/IOSS records for intra-EU distance sales of electronic services
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Luxembourg imposes no statutory FX repatriation deadline for export proceeds; the 180-day benchmark reflects internal anti-fraud best practice. The general tax audit limitation period is 3 years under Article 8 ACD, extended to 10 years where fraud or intentional concealment is established. Where export zero-rating or place-of-supply relief is claimed without the required proof (missing SAD, transport documents, or B2B customer VAT evidence), the AEDT claws back the VAT unpaid, applies default interest of 0.8% per month, and imposes administrative penalties of 10%-50% of the tax due. Criminal VAT fraud under Article 74 of the VAT Law and the Criminal Tax Code carries fines up to EUR 250,000 and imprisonment of 8 days to 5 years, with joint and several liability of directors and managers for the clawback.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL), functioning within the Eurosystem; market conduct, AML and payment institution supervision by the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF); no separate foreign-exchange control administration exists for Luxembourg due to euro membership.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible. Luxembourg maintains zero exchange-control restrictions on either current-account or capital-account transactions pursuant to Article 63 TFEU and the consolidated BCL circular framework. Dividend and profit remittance are unimpeded by FX approval; the only material frictions are the statutory 15% Luxembourg dividend withholding tax (treaty-reducible) and the obligation to file an annual corporate income tax return before effective clearance of large distributions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None applicable. Luxembourg imposes no statutory surrender, mandatory conversion ratio, or repatriation deadline on export proceeds. The SARL may lawfully hold and denominate export receipts in EUR or any foreign currency indefinitely, provided cross-border transactions above EUR 12,500 per item are reported to the BCL for balance-of-payments statistics.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État (BCEE/Spuerkeess)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (multicurrency current account with SEPA and SWIFT access)
Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account
Capital Escrow Account (blocked deposit for SARL minimum capital) and FX facility
Operational Account and trade finance facility
Operational Account (EUR/USD) with notional cash pooling

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Medium as a secondary disbursement and collections rail, Low as the sole statutory or treasury bank. EU-licensed electronic money institutions (Wise EU, Airwallex EU, Revolut Business) accept Luxembourg SARLs and issue segregated EU IBANs under CSSF e-money passporting rules; however, they cannot serve as the depositary bank for the SARL statutory minimum capital (EUR 12,000) under the amended Law of 10 August 1915, and they do not provide committed credit, letters of credit, or interbank FX forward lines. Mercury ACH is legally unavailable to non-US entities and must be excluded from the design. CSSF Circular 19/732 requires any EMI to apply reciprocal know-your-customer checks, making the EMI acceptable strictly as a non-bank payment account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Fully remote onboarding is permitted for EU-resident directors and ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) through CSSF-compliant real-time video identification or a qualified electronic signature under eIDAS, supplemented by a notarized, apostilled corporate bundle. Non-EU resident UBOs are routinely required to attend an in-person interview at the entity's Luxembourg bank branch or to execute a sworn attestation before a Luxembourg notary. All tier-1 banks, as a prudential minimum, require at least one physical board meeting of the SARL's authorized signatories at onboarding for signature specimen authentication.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO or intermediate holding entity domiciled in a high-risk, zero-tax, or non-Cooperative Jurisdiction (e.g., offshore layers in the ownership chain).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete chain of title from ultimate individuals to the SARL; tax residency certificates (Formulaire 100 / LIR 160 Certificat de Résidence) for every intermediate entity; three years of corporate income tax returns; notarized share register; economic-substance narrative with office lease, payroll records, and board minutes evidencing Luxembourg management substance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency, low-value B2B SaaS receivables aggregated from a large base of global micro-merchants via Stripe billing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed master subscription agreements with the top-20 customers; platform analytics and transaction-flow summary; SOC 2 Type II report; recognized revenue schedule per IFRS 15; and a reconciliation statement mapping Stripe settlement files to the target bank account to demonstrate a legitimate, auditable revenue stream.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Upstream intercompany shareholder loan with non-arm's-length pricing or absence of a written loan agreement.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized loan agreement (acte de prêt) with maturity and interest schedule; OECD transfer pricing comparability analysis and benchmarking study; group intercompany policy memorandum; BCL balance-of-payments declaration for each disbursement exceeding EUR 12,500; and draft Luxembourg CIT return reflecting arm's-length interest.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: History of cryptocurrency-derived or ambiguously structured investor funds entering the SARL capital base.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-wealth statement certified by a Luxembourg notary; twelve months of exchange or brokerage statements showing the disposal trail; tax clearance certificate (Avis de taxation) for the investor; a notarized afﬁdavit of lawful origin; and confirmation that no proceeds emanate from sanctioned wallets or mixing services.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid circular movement of funds between EU EMIs and the tier-1 bank account without clear economic purpose codes.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Treasury policy memorandum approving the payment rails; individually matched purpose codes per transfer (e.g., SUPP – supplier payment, RENT – operating expense); underlying invoices or contracts; monthly EMI-to-bank reconciliation; and a notarized corporate resolution authorizing the treasury routing matrix.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing for equity injection: SEPA Credit Transfer (EUR, intra-EEA) or SWIFT MT103 (non-EUR) with ISO 20022 purpose code 'CAPT' (Capital Contribution) or 'EQUI' (Equity-Like Contribution). Each injection must be accompanied by the notarized capital increase resolution, a bank confirmation of release of the €12,000 minimum capital, a BCL balance-of-payments declaration for transactions above €12,500, and a shareholder source-of-funds certificate. Shareholder loan injections require a signed notarized loan agreement, arm's-length interest schedule, and transfer pricing file retained before the first inbound credit is accepted.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: SEPA Credit Transfer in EUR for EU vendor disbursements; SWIFT MT103 for non-EU settlements and cloud-infrastructure vendor payments; Commercial Letters of Credit under UCP 600 for strategic hardware and large-scale IT procurement; and SWIFT MT202 COV only for interbank cover transfers associated with customer payments. Settlement executes over TARGET2 for EUR high-value, STEP2/TIPS for SEPA mass payments, and CHIPS/Fedwire for USD legs; no FX approval or dual-rate protocol applies to outbound disbursements.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla EUR/USD FX forwards under the 2013 ISDA/FX Master Agreement or 2013 Global Master FX Agreement with a Luxembourg-licensed credit institution
EUR/USD cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) for intercompany loan and treasury arbitrage purposes
Purchased (long) plain-vanilla FX options for downside protection against adverse USD/EUR swings in cloud-usage costs
Currency swaps (exchange of principal and interest) with maturities aligned to vendor invoice cycles, cleared bilaterally under ISDA CSA or centrally under EMIR if thresholds are exceeded

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) technically permissible under CSSF rules, but economically unnecessary for EUR; reserved exclusively for exotic-currency exposure (e.g., USD/INR or USD/BRL) on developer-tool licensing revenue from restricted market corridors

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) / Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a 31 December financial year-end, the shareholders' meeting must approve the annual accounts by 30 June; the approved accounts must be filed with the RCS within one month after approval, normally by 31 July.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers formal notice by LBR, administrative fines under the RCS fee schedule, publication of the default in the RCS electronic collection, and repeated non-filing over two consecutive years may lead to an administrative strike-off procedure (radiation). Directors and shareholders remain liable for unpaid obligations after administrative removal.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Combined annual corporate income tax, municipal business tax and net wealth tax return (Form 100/600 package)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a financial year ending 31 December, the combined annual tax return must be filed by 30 June of the following calendar year; extensions may be granted on reasoned request. Final tax balances are payable upon notice of assessment.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid balance and late payments accrue interest at 0.6% per commenced month; late filing can attract procedural fines up to EUR 10,000. Continued non-filing permits ACD to impose assessed estimates and enforce collection by seizure; it does not directly trigger RCS strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial owner annual confirmation (UBO / RBE declaration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) / Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation must be filed by 31 March following the calendar year. Any change in beneficial ownership, including a share transfer that creates or ceases an UBO, must be declared within one month of the change.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or false confirmation is punishable by administrative fines and criminal fines up to EUR 30,000; directors may also have their court-approved removal procured for persistent non-compliance. The RBE filing is a condition for issuance of a current UBO excerpt for banking and transactional use.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual VAT return and EC sales list reconciliation (where the SARL is registered for VAT)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: The calendar-year VAT reconciliation statement and the annual EU sales list are due by 31 March following the reporting year. Monthly and quarterly VAT filers must also file by the legal deadlines for each period.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing or payment leads to default interest of 0.6% per month, late-filing penalties up to EUR 5,000, and possible reassessment with 20% surcharge. Persistent VAT default enables AEDT tax seizure but does not by itself trigger RCS strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Luxembourg SARL is required to appoint an independent certified auditor (réviseur d'entreprises agréé) when it exceeds at least two of the following three thresholds on two consecutive balance-sheet dates: total balance sheet EUR 4,400,000; net turnover EUR 8,800,000; average annual workforce 50 employees. Public-interest entities, credit institutions, and regulated financial entities are always audited.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP as implemented by the Law of 19 December 2002 on commercial companies applies to individual statutory annual accounts; EU-endorsed IFRS is permitted or required for consolidated accounts in appropriate listed groups. Small SARLs may use the simplified annual-accounts framework under Lux GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the Luxembourg law of 13 January 2019, the SARL must keep the RBE declaration accurate and confirm its contents annually through the LBR portal before 31 March. During confirmation, share transfers in the prior year must be reviewed; any transfer that changes the identity or extent of beneficial ownership must be declared to the RBE within one month. Directors are responsible for the declaration, and institutions may request an authenticated UBO excerpt for AML checks.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Combined headline burden in Luxembourg City for FY2024/2025: 24.94% (CIT 17% + employment fund surcharge 1.19% + municipal business tax 6.75%). Statutory incentives: 80% exemption for qualifying net IP income (nexus approach); participation exemption for dividends and capital gains under the €10M / 12-month holding rules; 30% EBITDA interest limitation (ATAD) rather than a general thin-cap rule; no WHT on outgoing royalties/interest.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: unlimited (annual utilization capped at EUR 3,000,000 + 50% of excess taxable income)
